The workbook generation failed to populate specific cell ranges, resulting in 'None' values where numeric data was expected.
The verifier failed with AssertionError in test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats. Specifically, cells in ranges H12:L17 (top block) and H35:L40 (net metric) returned None instead of expected floats like 612.5 or 4.499. Ensure the logic for task_sheet(wb) correctly maps and writes calculated values to the exact coordinate references defined in the EXPECTED_TOP and EXPECTED_NET maps.
